explanation: Hanks won Best Actor two years running, for Philadelphia (1993) and Forrest Gump (1994). Spencer Tracy had done the same in the 1930s.

claims.text: Tom Hanks played Forrest Gump and voiced Woody in Toy Story.
Tim Allen voiced Buzz Lightyear, and neither he, Robin Williams nor Kevin Costner played Forrest Gump.
Hanks won the Best Actor Oscar for Philadelphia (1993) and for Forrest Gump (1994), in consecutive years.
Spencer Tracy also won Best Actor in consecutive years, in the 1930s.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Claims: every claim listed, risk at or above the C26 floor; the schema's riskReason list has no only or counterintuitive, so such claims carry the nearest listed reason. Datasets: no pinned dataset covers film or TV facts, so every high-risk claim here needs checker evidence from the web. Rival test: Tim Allen voiced Buzz in the same film and Robin Williams was the era's other big comic voice actor; Costner was a 1990s leading man. None fits both roles. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: the work is known worldwide and the options need no single country's local knowledge. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 23 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json, no match. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: none beyond the high-risk claims flagged for external evidence.
